theorems.name: Tetrahedral normal realization of the four FCC slices
theorems.statement: The four vectors n_i have squared norm 3, pairwise dot product -1, zero sum, and their six pairwise cross-product lines are the six FCC <110> line families.

theorems.name: Orthogonal overlap-transport dichotomy
theorems.statement: For two distinct slice normals, exactly two orthogonal maps fix the shared line pointwise and send n_i to n_j: the proper short rotation A_ij and the improper bisector reflection H_ij.
theorems.boundary: The bare K4 incidence graph does not choose between the two maps.

theorems.name: Determinant controls chirality transport
theorems.statement: For an orthogonal bridge T with T n_i=n_j, one has T J_i T^{-1}=det(T) J_j. Proper bridges preserve J and mirror bridges reverse J.

theorems.name: Canonical proper bridge from the oriented normal sphere
theorems.statement: Ambient orientation plus the shortest great-circle rule selects A_ij uniquely among the two overlap bridges.
theorems.boundary: This is canonical at the embedded carrier level, not yet derived from native P000 Cell transition semantics.

theorems.name: Tetrahedral face half-turn holonomy
theorems.statement: For every ordered triple of distinct slices, A_ki A_jk A_ij=(2/3)n_i n_i^T-I. It fixes n_i and negates the starting slice plane P_i.

theorems.name: Face holonomy is the square of the local chiral operator
theorems.statement: On P_i, Hol_ijk=-I=J_i^2. Thus J_i is a chirality-selected square root of the tetrahedral face holonomy.

theorems.name: Normal-face spherical area
theorems.statement: The normal-tetrahedron face has side cosine -1/3, vertex-angle cosine -1/2, vertex angle 2*pi/3, and spherical excess pi.

theorems.name: Carrier Euler holonomy
theorems.statement: Geodesic parallel transport around one normal-tetrahedron face satisfies Hol|P_i=exp(pi J_i)=-I; after pi_rot=pi this is exp(pi_rot J_i)=-I.

theorems.name: Geometric realization of the half-turn lift ambiguity
theorems.statement: The two orientations of a face boundary have lifted phases +pi and -pi but the same endpoint -I, realizing the two shortest lifts of the finite half-turn residue.

theorems.name: Chirality flatness differs from phase flatness
theorems.statement: All proper edge bridges have trivial determinant cocycle and coherently preserve J, yet every proper triangular loop has the nontrivial central phase -I.

theorems.name: Mirror loop is not complex-linear phase transport
theorems.statement: A triangular product of mirror bridges has determinant -1, fixes the starting normal, acts as a tangent reflection, and conjugates J_i to -J_i.
